schema:name: Data Driven Insights
schema:description:
The strategic use of operational and financial data to guide decision-making across the healthcare organization. It transforms raw metrics into actionable intelligence that helps leaders understand past performance and predict future needs.

It allows administrators to identify patterns, reduce waste, and optimize resource allocation based on facts rather than guesswork. This ultimately improves both organizational efficiency and the overall quality of care delivered to patients.

Example: "Using payroll analytics to identify high-turnover departments and tracking shift-differential trends to better manage the hospital's labor budget."
